narrative.northStar: The Instrument Panel Beside the Terminal
narrative.overview:
The dashboard is the developer-tool dashboard a user already knows, played straight: an overview table first, then per-project views, on a neutral zinc ground with hairline borders, one blue accent, and small charts. It sits beside a terminal and an agent session and is read cold, so every surface answers a question in a glance and points at the command that changes the answer. It is a window, not a control panel: nothing on the page edits, accepts or rejects.

Density is medium-high and calm. Cards are flat white on an off-white ground (near-black in dark mode), separated by 1px zinc lines rather than shadows. Colour is spent only where it carries meaning: blue for links, focus, selection and the first data series; green, amber, red and grey only for state, and always beside a word. The system does not develop its own visual identity; the quality bar is Vercel's dashboard and GitHub Actions and Insights.

Light and dark follow the system (`prefers-color-scheme`). Dark values are their own steps tuned for the dark surface, not an inversion; they live in the sidecar's `colorMeta.<token>.dark`.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral zinc ground, white cards, 1px hairline borders, no decorative shadow.
One blue accent for links, focus ring, selection tint and series 1.
Status tones (ok, warn, bad, off) each come as text, soft fill and line, and never appear without words.
System UI sans with tabular figures; mono for paths, ids, models, queries and commands.
8px-radius cards, fully rounded pills, small charts on one axis with a Table toggle.
Every fix sentence pairs with a copyable command.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: A status tone never stands alone: a pill carries its label ("Healthy", "Stopped", "stale"), a toned figure sits under its label, and a fix sentence states the fact in words.

rules.name: The Quiet When Healthy Rule
rules.body: An ok state does not tint figures. Stat values take a tone only for warn, bad or off; healthy values stay ink.

rules.name: The Series Are Not Status Rule
rules.body: Charts draw with series-1..3 in a fixed order, never with the ok/warn/bad tones, even when a series means "accepted" or "rejected".

rules.name: The Typed Things Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Paths, ids, model names, search queries, channel names and commands set in mono; everything else is sans.

rules.name: The Columns Line Up Rule
rules.body: Counts, costs, times and axis labels use tabular figures; numeric table columns align right.

rules.name: The Cards Below Large Rule
rules.body: Below `lg` (1024px) the projects table becomes a list of stacked cards: name and status pill, root in mono, one metadata line, and the fix line under it. The table only renders from `lg` up.

rules.name: The Place Is the URL Rule
rules.body: Project, view, tab and selected item live in the query string, so a reload reopens the same place.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, tables and banners separate with a 1px border, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Fix Has a Command Rule
rules.body: Every fix sentence that has a remedy carries it as a copyable Command; a fix without a command (parked entries) says why none applies.

rules.name: The One Axis Rule
rules.body: A chart plots on one axis, stacks its series in a fixed order, and offers a Table toggle with the same numbers.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Bar lists shown side by side share one maximum, so equal counts draw equal bars.

rules.name: The Empty States Say What Happened Rule
rules.body: An empty list or chart states the fact plainly and, when one exists, the command that changes it ("No projects yet: run crank-mem init in a project.").

dos: **Do** pair every status tone with its word: a Pill label, a figure under its label, or a fix sentence.
**Do** give each project row exactly one status pill, from the first problem in capture order.
**Do** put a copyable Command beside every fix sentence that has a remedy.
**Do** plot charts on one axis with series-1, series-2, series-3 in that order, and keep the Table toggle.
**Do** pass one shared `max` to bar lists that sit side by side.
**Do** switch the projects table to stacked cards below `lg` (1024px).
**Do** set paths, ids, models, queries and commands in mono, and numbers in tabular figures.
**Do** write empty states as the fact plus the command, in GLOSSARY.md's words.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent hue; blue is the only one.
**Don't** use ok/warn/bad/off tones for decoration, chart series or category tags.
**Don't** separate cards with shadows; use the 1px hairline.
**Don't** add controls that edit, accept or reject memory; the dashboard is read-only.
**Don't** set labels in uppercase or add eyebrow text above headings.
